concepts.name: Number Sequences
concepts.description: Students observe ordered sequences of numbers and identify the rule used to generate each successive term. They explore increasing, decreasing, and repeating numerical patterns.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify the rule governing a number sequence and extend the sequence correctly.

concepts.name: Skip Counting
concepts.description: Skip counting involves counting forward or backward by a fixed interval. It strengthens multiplication skills and helps identify numerical relationships.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to generate number patterns using skip counting with different intervals.

concepts.name: Pattern Rules
concepts.description: Every pattern follows a logical rule based on operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, or repetition. Identifying the rule enables prediction of future terms.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to determine and explain the rule behind a given numerical pattern.

concepts.name: Geometric Patterns
concepts.description: Shapes can be arranged in repeating or growing patterns based on size, orientation, or position. Students analyze these arrangements to identify regularity.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and continue geometric patterns using shapes.

concepts.name: Growing Patterns
concepts.description: Growing patterns increase according to a specific rule, often by adding shapes or elements at each step.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to predict subsequent figures in a growing geometric pattern.

concepts.name: Patterns in Multiplication Tables
concepts.description: Multiplication tables exhibit repeating and predictable patterns that simplify mental calculations and strengthen number sense.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify recurring patterns in multiplication tables.

concepts.name: Even and Odd Number Patterns
concepts.description: Students investigate how even and odd numbers behave under addition and multiplication to recognize mathematical regularities.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and explain patterns involving even and odd numbers.

concepts.name: Square Number Patterns
concepts.description: Square numbers follow a recognizable sequence formed by multiplying a number by itself. Visual representations help students understand their growth.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to recognize and generate square number patterns.

concepts.name: Patterns in Nature
concepts.description: Natural objects such as flowers, leaves, shells, and honeycombs display repeating mathematical patterns. Students relate mathematics to the natural world through observation.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify mathematical patterns found in nature.

concepts.name: Patterns in Art and Design
concepts.description: Patterns are widely used in rangoli, textiles, architecture, and decorative art to create visually appealing designs.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to create and analyze repeating patterns used in art and design.

concepts.name: Logical Reasoning
concepts.description: Recognizing patterns develops logical thinking and problem-solving skills by encouraging students to identify relationships and make predictions.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to use logical reasoning to solve pattern-based problems.

concepts.name: Understanding Mathematical Patterns
concepts.description: This chapter develops students' ability to recognize, analyze, extend, and create numerical and geometric patterns while strengthening logical reasoning and mathematical thinking.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify, extend, and create mathematical patterns and apply pattern recognition to solve real-life problems.
